fixed.problem: S-1/S-2 (D6-1): any card answer started a paid session the person never pressed. On the bench, Try again on a failed card started a 'message' session ('Done: ... again: a session started.'). Root cause: every answer path called resumeWork -> scheduler.requestStart with a non-person trigger. Quiet hours were read through a port nothing set, so they held nothing. A schedule wrote its fired key before its start left the line.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/scheduler-monthly.test.ts (S-1 describe: fired key, quiet hours hold a schedule's start); apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'd1109-starts-engine, run C' > 'S-1: with quiet hours on now POST /sessions starts at once ...'; apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'after its retries ... Try again prepares it for the person's Start' (before, the answer started a session)
fixed.how: StartRequest.by (person|schedule|hands_off|continuation) plus startByOf. Quiet hours (compose's cached reader, refreshed at each tick) hold every start the person did not press. The fired key is written only when the start leaves the line. resumeWork is replaced by prepareAnswer -> prepareWork (session/prepared-work.ts) on every answer path: budget-card, intake, person-questions, cannot-run-card, findings, pr-answers, late-approval. The card's Done line keeps the prepared outcome (change_card.start).
fixed.check_in_the_app: On a project with no session running, let a task fail (title starting 'Fail me' on the bench), open the Inbox, press Try again. The card's Done line reads 'Trying "..." again: it runs at your next Start.' and no new row appears under Sessions. Press Start: the task runs.

fixed.problem: S-10: every credential wait started a session at the reset, whoever had started the work. The person's own session had no way to go on, no Cancel, no hold for quiet hours, and no single wait per project.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/continuation.test.ts 'quiet hours hold it ...'. The sentence named 15:00 instead of 17:00: the cached quiet hours were not refreshed after a Settings change. Also apps/ui/test/project.test.tsx 'the person's session waiting to go on offers Cancel the wait'.
fixed.how: A kept continuation sits on limits.waiting[].kept (keepContinuation, dropKeptStart, keptContinuationOf). The wake starts it once (by: 'continuation', the rest of its budget, first line 'Goes on with your session of 10:00.'). Quiet hours hold it; Cancel (POST /projects/:id/continuation/cancel and 'Cancel the wait' in the Start dialog), Stop all and project removal drop it. No continuation is kept after Stop after this task, a wrap-up, or no budget left. A Start while it waits answers 'Your session of 10:00 goes on by itself at 15:00.'. POST /sessions with continues goes on with the rest of an ended session's budget. Quiet hours are refreshed before every start the person did not press and before every sentence that names their end. Wait words: '; then your session goes on.' or '; then it runs at your next Start.'.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Hard to reach on the bench stand-in (the subscription path needs Claude Code). In the app: run a session on the subscription until its usage limit. The session ends with 'Waits until HH:MM (your subscription's limit); then your session goes on.'. Open Start: 'Nothing can run until HH:MM ...; then your session goes on.' with Cancel the wait. At the reset the session goes on by itself once, and its first log line is 'Goes on with your session of HH:MM.'.

Planning that waited for a credential is still drafted again by itself at the reset ('Planning waits until 15:40 (...) and starts by itself.'). It is a planning call the person asked for, not a session, and was kept. The owner may want it under D6 as well.

When a credential wait ends between ticks and the person presses Start, POST /sessions runs the wake first. The person's continuation starts, and their Start then queues behind it (result 'queued'). Honest, but a later Start may run a second session for what is left.

notes_for_other_areas: prepareWork(deps, req) / PreparePort (session/prepared-work.ts): call it after any action that makes a task ready (by: 'person' | 'system' | 'agent'). It returns {outcome, line, startedBy?}. Store the outcome with resume-work.ts recordStart(store, requestId, outcome). Words: preparedLine, preparedClause, preparedExplain (PreparedContext {running, startsByItself}). previewWork is the read-only sibling.
LiveSessions (session/live-sessions.ts): forProject(projectId) -> AdmitHandle with admit(taskIds, by, {partOf, before}), readmit(taskIds), closing. The runner registers one per live session.

StartRequest.by ('person'|'schedule'|'hands_off'|'continuation') plus continues, schedule; startByOf(req). The session plan carries plan.startedBy {by, continues?, continuesAt?} and plan.promise. New events: session.promised, session.joined, session.left_for_next_start, session.continues (CONTINUES_EVENT; line 'Goes on with your session of HH:MM.').

Continuation on the billing source: limits.waiting[].kept {by, continues?, budgetUsdMicro?, at}. Helpers in wiring/billing-pick.ts: keepContinuation, keepStartAtReset, dropKeptStart, keptContinuationOf, keptStartOf. noteWait(sourceId, projectId, agentId, sessionId?, kept?). C6's 'Start at 15:40' should use keepStartAtReset.

RuntimeApp.quietHours {refresh, isQuiet, endsAt}: refresh before any start the person did not press. RuntimeApp.continuations {waiting, cancel, dropAll}. billing.waits.now returns kept:true when a continuation or a kept Start waits.

Routes: POST /projects/:id/continuation/cancel (ContinuationCancelView {cancelled, sentence}); POST /sessions takes continues; StartCheckView.laterBeyond and blocked.kept. The client has cancelContinuation(projectId). The fake daemon mirrors all of them.

CommandPorts.prepareWork / previewWork / startWaits. session.start has askFromChat: true. start_by_itself is appended last in SETTING_SPECS (personOnly; SettingEffectContext.project), so chat_ask_above and credential_policy go after it. Owner-question defaults used: the continuation is held by quiet hours; the setting is per project only and off.
summary_cache.start_pending (startPendingOf, keepStartPending, dropStartPending) keeps a hands-off start that could not run now. C4's 'Make one project' should carry or drop it.

StartBlockedFacts.needsYou names a task waiting on the person's card when nothing is ready (C2-left-2). pauseSaid and madeProgress now count report and handoff changes (C2-left-3). executor runIdAt uses monotonicId (C2-left-5).
